judge.name: Contributor 54
judge.method: One exhaustive read of each artifact against the current bar, vendored Machines API schema and primary Fly documentation; no authored files changed and no walk or tests run.

doubts.reason: The fake pool supplies no running image, so connecting and reconnecting are intentions behind metadata reads, not verified guest connectivity. The frame discloses this and keeps it a bounded doubt.

The outline says next morning and next day but does not give a starting time. The executable life starts at its walker clock default, and uses 12h for the later volume reconciliation. Prefer neutral relative-time prose or a stated daytime origin if changing the story for another reason.

The 24h removal delay is explicitly disclosed as simulation. Public documentation does not establish that exact delay. It must not be reported as measured Fly timing. Pending_destroy itself is supported by the vendor engineer at https://community.fly.io/t/volume-stuck-in-pending-destroy-for-11-hours/14743

reviewed.conclusion: Every beat was checked for actor/grant, cause, sitting, state sequence, payload, provenance and documented door. The organization token grant covers this single organization and its resources.
